program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff-pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),        # diff-pair length
    "Itail": (40e-6, 20e-6, 80e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror / CS output gm/Id (matched)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS length (mirror + output device)
    "I2":    (240e-6, 120e-6, 330e-6),  # second-stage current
    "Cc":    (0.6e-12, 0.3e-12, 1.2e-12),
    "kRz":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = kRz/gm6
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source length
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    gmidn = 11.0
    Ln = p["Ln"]
    It = p["Itail"]; I1 = It / 2; I2 = p["I2"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    # bias: ibias diode, tail and output-sink mirrors (same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, It, vds=0.2)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, I2, vds=0.9)

    # diff pair (source ~0.2 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.7, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and CS output device, identical density
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)
    m3d = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)

    Rz = p["kRz"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> non-inverting from vinp
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3d)
    n.dev("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RZ", "y", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL)))
    p_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    wz_inv = Cc * (Rz - 1 / m6.gm)
    fz = 1 / (2 * PI * wz_inv) if wz_inv > 0 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_mirror)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I2 / (CL + Cc))
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "swing": swing, "polarity": 1}
